kua_numbers.note: Kua 5 has no trigram. Men use Kua 2 and women use Kua 8.

direction_types.meaning: Your best direction for growth, success, and opportunity.
tips: Face this direction when you work or study.
Sit this way in meetings and interviews.
Keep this area of your home bright and tidy.
direction_types.hdb_tip: You cannot move the door, so turn your desk or sofa to face this direction instead.

direction_types.meaning: A direction linked to wellbeing, rest, and support.
tips: Point your bed head this way for restful sleep.
Face it while eating meals.
Keep the area calm and clutter-free.
direction_types.hdb_tip: If the bed is fixed by the window, angle the headboard or swap pillow ends to face this way.

direction_types.meaning: A direction for harmony in relationships and family.
tips: Good for couples' bed placement.
Face it for family talks.
Place family photos in this area.
direction_types.hdb_tip: Arrange the living room sofa to face this way for warmer family time.

direction_types.meaning: A direction for calm, clarity, and personal growth.
tips: Face it to study or meditate.
Useful for calm decisions.
Keep a small plant or lamp here.
direction_types.hdb_tip: Set up a corner study table facing this way, even in a small bedroom.

direction_types.meaning: A mildly unfavourable direction linked to small setbacks.
tips: Use this area for storage.
Avoid facing it when working.
Keep it neat and well-lit.
direction_types.hdb_tip: Use the household shelter or storeroom side for storage if it falls here.

tips: Do not face it during important tasks.
Keep it uncluttered.
Soften the space with calm colours.
direction_types.hdb_tip: If your door faces this way, keep the entrance bright and add a welcoming mat.

direction_types.meaning: Linked to scattered energy and tangled relationships.
tips: Avoid placing your bed head here.
Use it for practical purposes.
Keep it clean and airy.
direction_types.hdb_tip: Turn the bed so your head points elsewhere, even by a small angle.

direction_types.meaning: Your least favourable direction. Simply avoid it where you can.
tips: Avoid sitting with your face toward it.
Keep this area simple.
Do not let clutter build up here.
direction_types.hdb_tip: If the main door faces this way, focus on placing your desk and bed in lucky directions instead.
